description: Web search with page content: search the web and read the top pages in ONE call. Returns 10 results (title, url, snippet, date) plus the clean text of the best pages (read 0-5), with fetch time, sha256, publication and last-modified dates (each with its source) and canonical URL; a complete flag, and require_complete for all-or-nothing (not charged). French and Canada by default for French queries; official-sources mode (governments, registries, courts, laws); freshness filter; site: restriction. No results = HTTP 404 = not charged. Input: query, optional read, official, lang, country, freshness, site. Costs $0.008 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/web-search with an x402 client.

max_chars.description: Max characters of text per page (default 6,000; up to 50,000 for whole pages)

query.description: Question or keywords; Brave operators allowed (site:, "exact", -word)

read.description: Top pages to fetch and return as clean text (default 3)

require_complete.description: If true, a call that cannot read every available page returns an error and is not charged

name: web_search
